title: State must pay ₹30 lakh compensation even for deaths of privately hired manual scavengers: Bombay High Court
description: The Aurangabad Bench of Bombay High Court recently held that the State is liable to pay ₹30 lakh as compensation for manual scavenging even if such deceased persons were hired by private persons and not government bodies [Sharda Maroti Chopwad & Anr v. State of Maharashtra & Ors.].
